newsitem.title: USA: BPA limits Thursday power volumes, raises prices.
newsitem.headline: BPA limits Thursday power volumes, raises prices.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised prices for non-firm power during "valley peaks" by $2.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Thursday deliveries and limited sales volumes to 500 MW, the agency said Wednesday.
BPA offered non-firm power during hours ending 1200-1800 PDT and 2200 PDT at $15.00 per MWh for Northwest deliveries and $16.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
The agency continued to refrain from offering surplus power during morning and evening peaks.
Non-firm power for hours ending at 0600 PDT and 2300 PDT was raised by 50 cents to $10.00 for all deliveries.
Prices for off-peak non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 PDT and 2400 PDT were also raised by 50 cents to $9.50.
Firm power during off-peak hours on Wednesday was unchanged at $9.00.
